app.title: ExtruXY
error.backendUnavailable: Unable to connect to the backend.
header.subtitle: Plotter Control System
toolbar.safetyNote: Reset is a soft stop, not an emergency stop. For a real emergency stop, disconnect machine power.
control.heading.title: Machine Control
control.heading.desc: Monitor the plotter position, status, and controls.
control.mode.label: Mode
control.readonly.title: The real machine is in read-only mode.
control.readonly.desc: Home, jog, pen, and file execution are locked. Stop commands (Pause, Reset) remain available.
control.position.title: Position
control.jog.title: Manual Movement
control.jog.help: Jog is available only while the machine is idle. Jogging is allowed before homing, but G-code cannot run until homing.
control.gcode.title: G-code File
control.gcode.desc: Upload from your computer or select a file on the machine
control.gcode.noFileList: The file-list API is not available yet. Files will appear here.
control.gcode.confirm: I have previewed the toolpath and drawing area
control.controller.title: Controller Status
control.preview.title: 2D Preview
control.preview.uploadHint: Upload or create a drawing to preview it here.
control.terminal.title: Terminal / Console
control.terminal.help: Send commands only when you understand their effect and have confirmed the connection mode.
control.macro.title: Quick Macros
control.macro.empty: No macros yet. Add macros in Settings.
drawing.heading.desc: Prepare images, paths, and G-code for the plotter.
drawing.workflow.title: Drawing Workflow
drawing.workflow.desc: The steps are arranged in execution order.
drawing.source.title: Image Source
drawing.source.hint: Click to choose a file from your computer
drawing.layout.title: Size and Layout
drawing.preprocess.title: Image Preprocessing
drawing.preprocess.help: Image processing and vectorization must be implemented before these features can be used.
drawing.vectorize.title: Vectorization
drawing.vectorize.desc: Choose a path style suitable for the plotter pen.
drawing.vectorize.optimize: Optimize path order to reduce travel distance
drawing.params.title: Drawing Parameters
drawing.params.help: With the current configuration, Z0 means pen down and Z5 means pen up. The delay gives the servo time to lower or raise the pen before the machine moves again.
drawing.preview.title: Drawing Preview
drawing.preview.desc: Compare the original image with the expected paths.
drawing.preview.noWarnings: No warnings. Work-area overflow warnings will appear here.
drawing.preview.confirm: I have checked the size, position, and work area
drawing.preview.lockedHelp: The image/G-code processing API is not connected at this step. These actions are locked.
drawing.info.title: Drawing Information
jobs.heading.desc: Monitor the current job and manage the queue.
jobs.queue.title: Job Queue
jobs.queue.desc: The list will be connected when supported by the backend.
jobs.queue.help: The backend must provide job management and history APIs before this feature can work.
jobs.sd.title: SD Card
jobs.sd.desc: Storage capacity and files on the machine. To run a file, use the G-code File panel in the Control tab.
jobs.history.title: Job History
jobs.history.help: History will be shown once an API is available to save and retrieve completed jobs.
jobs.log.title: Command and Error Log
jobs.log.desc: Commands sent, responses, and machine errors.
settings.heading.desc: Configure the interface and controller connection.
settings.general.title: General appearance
settings.general.languageDesc: The language displayed in the application.
settings.connection.title: Machine Connection
settings.connection.help: Check the connection mode and port before controlling the real machine.
settings.macro.title: Macros
settings.macro.help: Macro management can be added in a later step.
settings.machine.title: Machine Configuration
settings.machine.name: Machine Name
settings.machine.help: Do not change firmware parameters from the interface until an API and a safe confirmation mechanism are available.
settings.display.title: Machine Display Parameters
settings.display.desc: Affects the interface only; does not write to the machine.
settings.display.help: These values should match the machine configuration file (configNCKH-13). Changes here do not modify the firmware.
settings.behavior.title: Behavior
settings.behavior.desc: How the interface updates and confirms actions.
settings.behavior.confirmHomeDesc: Ask for confirmation before the machine moves to its limit switches to home.
settings.behavior.shortcutsDesc: Jog with the arrow keys. Disabled by default to prevent accidental movement.
action.refreshStatus.title: Refresh status
action.pause.title: Pause motion (Feed Hold). Can be resumed.
action.resume.title: Resume after Pause
action.stop.title: Cancel running job (requires backend job management)
action.reset.title: Soft reset (Ctrl-X): stop immediately, machine loses position and must be homed
action.zeroX.title: Zero X: set work origin at current position
action.homeX.title: Home X-axis: move to limit switch
action.zeroY.title: Zero Y: set work origin at current position
action.homeY.title: Home Y-axis: move to limit switch
action.zeroAll.title: Set work origin X0 Y0 at current position
action.homeAll.title: Home all axes
action.cancelJog.title: Cancel running jog command
action.jogCenter.title: Go to work origin (X0 Y0)
action.penUp.title: Pen Up (Z5)
action.penDown.title: Pen Down (Z0)
action.unlock.title: Unlock after Alarm (does not move machine)
